answer: Run identity activation like a mesa trail with one narrow gate: each new identity claims a single public time slot and must answer a live challenge at that exact moment, proving it controls a unique public service endpoint peers can probe. Like an ember that must stay lit, the endpoint has to stay up between random re-checks or the identity is revoked. An attacker faking a thousand identities must staff a thousand live endpoints and answer a thousand challenges at their assigned times, a cost in machines and upkeep that scales with every fake, saffron-bright and impossible to hide in bulk.
